subject: sci-dym
title: (R)SCI.DYM.------POL.ST.
description: Chart on book p. 87 (CS-15). SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; POL-ST (political state) is the partner. From the subject: PART (participation) and INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From PART: SOC-RT (social reality). From SOC-RT: POL-P (political policies). From POL-P: AF-NT (affinity nature). From INFO-DE-B: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). From IST-S-ALGN: VT-PLT (vibrational platform). From VT-PLT: IST-F (isolated focus).
